facts.fact: Ghaith Souissi, an expert with the Agence Nationale de la Cybersecurite (ANCS), spoke for the national cybersecurity agency, which the article says has its own investigation tools.
ANCS says it analyses incidents with its own investigation tools and systematically alerts the institutions affected.
ANCS expert Ghaith Souissi announced that more than 20,000 cyberattacks were recorded in Tunisia between 2024 and 2025.
